anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex arc with a broad radius, transitioning from the dorsal cranial midline towards the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak; the pixel length from the inflection point to the distal tip is approximately 1.2x the vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel junction where the descending slope of the melon meets the horizontal plane of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced notch or irregular indentation visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
